description_en: Queries the remediation records of a rule
description_zh: 查看指定规则的修正执行记录
kebab_example: aliyun config list-remediation-executions --config-rule-id cr-5392626622af00000000 --next-token aVCjqNaSy0Ps7zSMGu250000 --max-results 10 --execution-status Success --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRemediationExecutions

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：10~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The status of the remediation. Valid values:

Success
Failed
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行状态，取值：

Success：成功

Failed：失败
parameters.name: execution_status

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return for a single request
MaxResults.description_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

ExecutionCreateDate.description_en: The time when the remediation record was created
ExecutionCreateDate.description_zh: 修正执行记录创建时间

ExecutionInvocationId.description_en: The invocation ID of the remediation record

ExecutionResourceIds.description_en: The IDs of the resources to which the remediation belongs. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
ExecutionResourceIds.description_zh: 修正的资源ID，多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExecutionStatus.description_en:
The status of the remediation record. Valid values:

Success
Failed
ExecutionStatus.description_zh:
修正执行记录状态，取值：

Success：成功。

Failed：失败

ExecutionStatusMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the remediation fails
ExecutionStatusMessage.description_zh: 修正执行失败的错误信息
